subject: Nebula Analytics — pilot addendum / runway extension + one-off credits
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: expanded pilot runway + one-off credits for Nebula Analytics

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Quick background: Nebula ran a set of infra+latency benchmarks over the weekend against our TGI-llama-13b quantized profile and results look strong — throughput and latency hit the thresholds their infra team needs. They told me the remaining blockers are running a full-scale document ingestion + retrieval test (end-to-end) which will consume ~80-120k tokens over ~2–3 weeks.

Commercial signals: they already engaged procurement and legal, product is ready to commit to a Dedicated pilot if we give them an extra runway and a one-off token uplift so they can finish the tests before their budget sign-off. ARR opportunity if they convert is ~ $180k/yr; procurement indicated they prefer a PO vs. immediate credit-card billing.

Ask: can we approve a 100k token one-off credit and a 30-day extension to the standard PLG pilot window for Nebula (account: Nebula Analytics, contact: Alex Chen)? If you prefer, I can accept a smaller uplift + stricter usage cap, but they need something now to avoid switching to a competitor evaluation next week.

Attachments: nebula_performance_report_q1.csv (summary of weekend runs), nebula_po_draft.pdf (procurement-supplied draft PO).

Proposed gating: signed pilot addendum (covers usage cap + data retention + rollback), PO on file. Happy to take this to CRO for signoff if you want a second eyeball.

Thanks — Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: expanded pilot runway + one-off credits for Nebula Analytics

Jordan — thank you for the concise summary.

High level: I think Nebula is strategic enough to warrant a one-off concession to keep momentum. I don’t want to set a broad precedent, so we should keep this narrowly scoped and timeboxed.

My recommendation: approve a 75k token credit and a 21-day extension to the pilot window, contingent on: (1) signed pilot addendum (limits credit to evaluation workloads and specifies retention/SLA), (2) PO or procurement email confirming intent to proceed to Dedicated if tests validate, and (3) custody of logs for audit (we'll preserve perf logs for 90 days).

If Jordan thinks 75k won't be sufficient to close, say so now — we can escalate to CRO (Aditya Rao) for an additional uplift. I want legal to craft the addendum language so this doesn’t become a template for other PLG trials. Laura — can you draft a short addendum based on the attached template and post the DocuSign link?

Also: Finance — please treat this as a one-off pilot concession; do not change pricing or extend any credits beyond the stated cap without exec approval.

I'll loop in procurement/legal if needed, but I approve the approach above.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: expanded pilot runway + one-off credits for Nebula Analytics

Thanks — drafting now. A few legal items to be explicit about in the pilot addendum:

- Credit usage scope: credits only apply to inference tokens consumed by the evaluation pipelines identified in Schedule A; no retroactive use for unrelated projects.
- Timebox: 21 days from the amended start date; any extension requires another exec-level approval.
- Data and logs: Nebula must accept standard retention (90 days) and may not export Redwood internal logs; any security exceptions must be handled via an SOW.
- Liability/SLAs: No changes to base terms; trial credits provided "as-is" with no additional warranty.
- PO/Payment: If a PO is provided it should reference DL-2028-0037 and the addendum.

I'll produce a 1-page addendum (from pilot_addendum_template.docx) and upload to DocuSign. I will CC Finance and Procurement in the envelope.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex@nebula.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@nebula.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Nebula Analytics — pilot addendum / runway extension + one-off credits (approved)

Alex / Nebula team —

Following internal review, Redwood will approve the following for Nebula Analytics (Account: DL-2028-0037):

1) One-off credit: 75,000 tokens to be applied only to evaluation runs listed in the attached Schedule A.
2) Pilot extension: 21 additional days, effective from the amended start date in the DocuSign addendum.
3) Conditions: execution of the pilot addendum (DocuSign link sent by Laura), acknowledgement of data retention terms (90 days), and a PO or procurement email referencing DL-2028-0037.

Next steps (action owners):
- Laura will send the DocuSign addendum (Laura Bennett).
- Alex / Procurement to return signed addendum and PO (Nebula).
- Jordan to verify the evaluation runs and confirm the amended start date in our system so the 21-day window is recorded (Jordan Blake).
- Finance to apply the 75k credit once the signed addendum and PO are received; do not apply credit until paperwork is in place (Finance Ops).

Jordan — please send the DocuSign envelope link to Alex and keep me cc'd. Once we have the signed addendum + PO, treat this as approved and proceed toward Dedicated contract discussions.

Alex — happy to chat if you want to accelerate the DocuSign step today.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
